title: Services Manifest
description: Single-source-of-truth manifest enumerating every service surfaced by the admin-dashboard-api Control_Plane. The default Boot_Bundle is still started profile-less by Makefile/Compose; admin-dashboard-api/admin-dashboard-ui may appear here as observable services for health, logs, tests and links, while external infra such as postgres/vault may be referenced only from depends_on_services. Uniqueness of compose_service_name across entries is enforced by the Python loader (services/admin-dashboard-api/src/manifest.py) as a custom check, since uniqueItemProperties is not part of standard JSON Schema 2020-12.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Only value 1 is currently accepted.

services.description: Ordered list of Managed_Service entries. Order is presentational only; the API treats this as a set keyed by name and compose_service_name.

ManagedService.description: A single Managed_Service entry that the Control_Plane can start, stop, restart, run tests for, probe for health and stream logs from. External services (kind='external') run outside the Compose stack and are probed via HTTP for status display only.
ManagedService.$comment: depends_on_services and feature_flag_dependency are optional with default []. Schema-level cycle detection is not possible across array entries; the boot validator (platform/scripts/check_services_manifest_schema.py) and the Python loader perform DFS-based cycle detection at runtime over the full set of entries. For kind='external' entries, compose_service_name/compose_profile/env_example_path/health_endpoint/test_command are not required; instead base_url_env/base_url_default/probe_path/probe_method/probe_expected_status are used.

name.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier used by the REST API path /admin/services/{name}. Must start with a lowercase letter, may contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Length 2..41 characters.

kind.description: Drives kind-aware behavior in HealthProbe and the UI: http_service polls /healthz + /readyz over the Compose network; worker uses Temporal client ping; sidecar exposes HTTP only on the Compose internal network and is treated like a worker by HealthProbe (Compose-internal probe only); ui and infra fall back to assume-running when health_endpoint is null. external services run outside the Compose stack (e.g. vLLM, OpenAI, Anthropic) and are probed via HTTP for admin-dashboard status display.

compose_service_name.description: Exact key under services: in infra/docker-compose.yml. Used as the argv argument for docker compose up/stop/exec/logs.

compose_profile.description: Compose profile activated by the lifecycle handler (docker compose --profile <value>). By convention equal to name.

env_example_path.description: Workspace-root-relative path to the .env.example file whose left-hand-side (LHS) keys drive the Start form schema. For atlassian-mcp this points into services/atlassian_mcp_bitbucket/.

health_endpoint.description: HTTP path probed by HealthProbe for http_service entries (e.g. /healthz). null for worker/infra/ui entries that do not expose an HTTP health endpoint.

test_command.description: Full command string used by POST /admin/services/{name}/test (typically of the form 'docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec <svc> pytest tests/integration/ -v'). null when the service has no integration tests; the endpoint then returns 409.

depends_on_services.description: Names of services this entry depends on for cascade healthcheck and auto-start dependency-chain orchestration. Strings may reference other Managed_Service entries (by name) OR Boot_Bundle / external infra components (e.g. postgres, vault, temporal, atlassian_mcp_bitbucket) which do not appear as manifest entries. Cycle detection cannot be expressed at JSON Schema level across array entries; the Python loader and boot validator (platform/scripts/check_services_manifest_schema.py) reject manifests whose intra-manifest depends_on_services edges form a cycle. Default [].

feature_flag_dependency.description: Names of feature flags whose enabled state must be true before the Control_Plane will start this service (Q12). The lifecycle handler resolves each flag against feature_flags.yaml; if any required flag is disabled, start returns HTTP 409 with reason 'feature_flag_disabled' instead of running docker compose up. Default [].

optional.description: Marks an external provider as optional. Optional external providers are hidden and not probed until configured via their base_url_env/base_url_default or explicitly enabled via enabled_env.

enabled_env.description: Optional environment variable that enables an optional external provider when set to a truthy value such as 1/true/yes/on.

credential_env.description: Optional environment variable that holds the provider credential. When set, an optional external provider is considered configured and will be surfaced/probed.

smoke_test_command.description: Full command string used for smoke testing (typically a quick pytest run with --timeout). null when the service has no smoke tests.

connectivity_probe_command.description: Optional subprocess argv string (e.g. 'python -m src.scripts.probe_atlassian') executed by LifecycleService.start as Step 9.5 — after _wait_for_healthy returns healthy and before the final audit (R9, Q10). exit_code=0 marks credentials_status='ok'; non-zero stores the trimmed stderr in credentials_probe_detail and emits service_connectivity_probe_failed audit. The service is still considered 'running' regardless of probe outcome; the result drives the dashboard credentials banner only. Default null (no probe).

base_url_env.description: Environment variable name that holds the base URL for an external service (e.g. 'VLLM_BASE_URL'). Used by the external probe helper to resolve the target URL at runtime. Applicable only to kind='external' entries.

base_url_default.description: Default base URL for an external service when the env var (base_url_env) is not set or when no env var is specified (e.g. 'https://api.openai.com/v1'). Applicable only to kind='external' entries.

probe_path.description: HTTP path appended to the resolved base URL for liveness probing of an external service (e.g. '/models', '/messages'). Applicable only to kind='external' entries.

probe_method.description: HTTP method used for the external service probe request. Defaults to 'GET'. Applicable only to kind='external' entries.

probe_expected_status.description: Expected HTTP status code from a successful probe of an external service. Defaults to 200. Applicable only to kind='external' entries.
